limit_order_match_in_progress.meaning: a limit order matching (partial or full) is being processed through _processLimitBidOrder or _processLimitAskOrder
limit_order_match_in_progress.checkpoint: before the zero-cost trade guard evaluation during limit order matching

matched_amounts_disjoint_bits.meaning: the matched base amount and matched quote amount have no overlapping 1-bits (e.g., base = 256 and quote in 1..255, or 40 & 21)
matched_amounts_disjoint_bits.checkpoint: before the zero-cost trade guard evaluation during limit order matching

zero_cost_guard_triggered.checkpoint: during limit order matching guard evaluation

one_side_receives_without_sending.meaning: one side receives tokens without sending any
one_side_receives_without_sending.checkpoint: during limit order matching guard evaluation

traders_encounter_unexplained_failures_o.meaning: traders, especially algorithmic ones using round numbers, encounter unexplained failures

assumptions: The zero-cost trade guard is evaluated during limit order matching processing.
The matched base and quote amounts are observable at guard evaluation time.

unresolved.description: The report does not quote the exact zero-cost check expression or its operands, so the guard's internal condition cannot be bound beyond the stated 'one side receives tokens without sending any' observable.
The report does not specify whether matched amounts are caller-supplied inputs or derived from order state, nor the exact disjoint-bit test form.

limitations: The intent is encoded as a required-effect polarity: when one side receives tokens without sending any, the zero-cost guard should trigger; the report's 'only when' restriction is captured by treating the guard trigger as the required effect under that condition.
The impact is encoded as a grounded Boolean occurrence because the report gives no more specific observable for 'unexplained failures'.
The disjoint-bits precondition is encoded as a grounded Boolean because the report states the qualitative bit-disjointness condition without a single numeric definition to bind.
